notes.title: Patch Notes #2 - Bestiary Update
notes.notes:
[b](Redacted parts contain spoilers!)[/b]

[h2][b]Bestiary:[/b][/h2]
- The in-game menu now features a new page that displays descriptions of monsters you've encountered.
- Monster entries are primarily unlocked by damaging the monsters.
- There are over 80 entries available in the Bestiary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/606b4dc8ca3ccdbc47b9da1897afb4411eb5b60f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Miscellaneous Improvements[/b] (some of these were previously implemented)[b]:[/b][/h3]
- Unread Atlas entries (as well as Bestiary ones) are now highlighted with an exclamation mark until they are read.
- Added a "Mouse and Keyboard Recommended" text element in the main menu, which is displayed if a controller is being used, to guide players towards the optimal experience.
- Addressed a highly requested improvement by providing guidance in the late game for [spoiler]finding Gloomsouls. Once the Gloomsouls have been freed, speaking to Voidchild in the Chapel of Doom will reveal the locations where the souls can be found.[/spoiler]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
- In-game menus no longer extend beyond the screen when using an ultrawide monitor.
- Corrected an issue where burning [spoiler]all Dread Indoctrination tools without collecting all Gloomsouls would unlock the wrong ending.[/spoiler]

[h3][b][u]Read some more about the update and the enemy design in DOOMBLADE in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/922050/view/3650785607755073742]blog post #9[/url].[/u][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Map Markers Addition and Speedrun Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes #2:
[/h2][b](Redacted parts contain spoilers!)[/b]

We are excited to present an update with the changes that many in the community have been asking for and hopefully can greatly improve the gaming experience. You requested, we delivered. Let us know what you think! ⚔️❤️

[h3]Map Markers:
[/h3]- Players can now mark locations on the map with Map Markers
- The maximum amount of Map Markers placed on the map is 20

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/c686f3501b39e82d09737559108befeac63430bb.gif[/img]

[h3]Speedrunning Updates:
[/h3]
[b](Check out more below if you'd interested in speedrunning!)

[/b]- An in-game stopwatch can now be enabled under Options --> Video Settings
- Game time is now saved even when dying or quitting to main menu.
- While a room change is in progress, game time is not running anymore

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/9c24a09539d3c52072deafc3b9fc1f1c6f228d45.jpg[/img]
[h3]Level Design:
[/h3]- Updated level design in a room in which some players were experiencing navigation difficulties: [spoiler]After receiving Shadow Form, it was not that clear that you could pass a wall in the room to the right from Faceless Waste. There is now an additional space in the room which is more visible and should help with navigation issues.[/spoiler]

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3]- Fixed a visual bug that reset save slots' saved hours to 0 every time 24 hours had been played.
- Fixed a bug that enabled map drawing in a place it shouldn't have: [spoiler]When starting from a save inside the World Eater, map drawing was enabled after going to the Void even though it shouldn't have. The bug only affected the drawing of rooms already visited.[/spoiler]

[h2]Join the DOOMBLADE Speedrun Community![/h2]

Are you honing in your DOOMBLADE skills with lightning speed and precision? Ready to flaunt your impeccable navigation skills to the world? ⚡️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/aea2ec18b5670db7ad145231d0ccf53b5a4537d3.png[/img]

Guess what? The wait is over! [b]We've launched our official speedrun leaderboards for the full campaign! [/b]

Who can be the quickest in all of the Lowlands?   

Head over to https://www.speedrun.com/doomblade to submit your epic runs and claim your spot among the best of the best. Let the speedrun madness begin! 

[h3]Stay tuned for further updates and we greatly appreciate all of your support! 
[/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes #1:
[/h2][b](Redacted parts contain spoilers!)[/b]

[h3]Miscellaneous Changes:[/h3]
- Final Boss Fight changes to accomodate the controller experience better. The experience with Mouse and Keyboard is largely unaffected. [spoiler]Dread Lords cannot be attacked anymore when their shields are up. Being attackable while shielded added nothing meaningful to the gameplay. When playing with a controller, you could far too easily attack a Dread Lord by accident, because of aiming between so many attack targets on the screen while a lot of action was taking place.[/spoiler]
- Typo fix in a dialogue. [spoiler]The shop keeper in Wilderwood had a typo in their dialogue. They said 'midjudged' instead of 'misjudged'. While hilarious, this was not intended and has now been fixed.[/spoiler]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Small collision fix. [spoiler]The room left from the blue tristone piece had a poorly positioned collider which allowed the player to throw Nightmare Onions through a wall.[/spoiler]
- Sound fixes. A couple of sounds in a mid-late game area weren't connected to the Audio Options volume sliders so they played even with volume 0.
- The game was granting achievements for finishing a fight even though the player died and did not finish the fight. This occured always in the last wave of a fight and should now be fixed.

notes.title: DOOMBLADE - Release Window Reveal + Gamescom Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
GREETINGS, GLOOMLINGS

DOOMBLADE is at Gamescom, and to celebrate, it has decided that you mortals are getting a chance to wield it for just a little while. Until Gamescom ends (August 28th), you can play the DOOMBLADE demo from the comfort of your own home!

And that's not all! In its infinite grace, DOOMBLADE has allowed us to share with you that the game will be fully releasing in Q2 2023!

[previewyoutube=iGkmnmG4vXU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Demo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/9b31cb33c9b9b9e6c18883f225b1d3599ac95730.gif[/img]

What's in the demo, you ask? Well, it all begins by freeing DOOMBLADE from the chains that bind it. After that, you'll go on a journey through three different worlds to slay those who would stand in DOOMBLADE's way, ending with an awesome mini-boss fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240930/3bd3b0c0e38feaf2ab4cfb4fd1808b436ad70e77.gif[/img]

Sounds good, right? You can check out the DOOMBLADE demo yourself until the end of Gamescom (August 28th). If you miss out, don't worry! There will be other opportunities in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/922050/DOOMBLADE/

And if you have any feedback, don't hesitate to let us know! You can post it on the Steam forums, or [url=https://discord.com/invite/AhdePCp]join the community on Discord![/url]
